coastal.title: Why Vancouver Island municipalities are maintaining campfire bans through the Labour Day long weekend
coastal.description: A number of municipalities in the Greater Victoria area are maintaining campfire bans through the Labour Day long weekend, even as campfire bans on areas outside municipal boundaries have lifted throughout B.C.

kamloops.title: Critic calls on B.C. to salvage more wildfire-burned timber, province says that's 'unrealistic.' Here's why
kamloops.description: Kamloops-North Thompson MLA Ward Stamer is calling for the province’s salvage rate to rise to 25 per cent and for more efficient access to wildfire-damaged timber.

prince-george.title: Brink Forest Products to cut 50 jobs at its Prince George lumber plant
prince-george.description: Brink Forest Products cuts roughly 50 jobs at its Prince George, B.C., plant as the company reduces operations to 20 per cent citing a lack of fibre and U.S. tariff costs, among factors.

all.title: After an intense summer of wildfires, Lytton River Festival aims to bring life to the community
all.description: The Village of Lytton is hosting its annual festival this year, with a special emphasis on cultural history of Chinese people and the village's legacy.
